[SWS_DM_02165] Retrieval of SOVD content element data
⌈
To retrieve the value of an DiagnosticSovdContentElement, the DM shall eval-
uate the DiagnosticSovdContentElementData provided by [SWS_DM_02164]
and retrieve the data of the requested DiagnosticSovdContentElement(s)
from the returned DiagnosticSovdContentElementData object, by fetching
the content via ara::diag::DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWithKey::
GetContent, while ara::diag::DiagnosticSovdContentElementDataWith-
Key::GetName is matching the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdContentEle-
ment.
⌋
